# kcore_shared_filesystem (Resource)

CephFS share (`kctl create shared-filesystem`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_shared_filesystem" "home" {
  name         = "home"
  ceph_cluster = kcore_ceph_cluster.lab.name
  fs_name      = "home"

  client {
    name  = "web"
    paths = ["/"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ceph_cluster` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `client` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--client))
- `fs_name` (String)
- `quota_bytes` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
